C arc025.clients-infra OL ARC-025,GOV-012 DEFAULT ;; Named, typed and keyed clients are valid; choose the simplest model; outbound API clients belong in Infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.retry-when-fits OL RUN-016,DEP-011 MUST ;; Retry and circuit-breaker behaviour is added only when its semantics fit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.app-unaware OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Application does not need to know the external service uses HTTP. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc022.typed-client-singleton OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not capture a transient typed client inside a singleton without understanding lifetime implications. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov012.keyed-not-automatic OL GOV-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not choose keyed clients automatically, nor make typed/keyed/named clients mandatory universally. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-handlers EX ARC-025,API-011 MUST_NOT ;; Use DelegatingHandler only for genuine HTTP pipeline concerns, never for business decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Handler responsibility rule not in the oracle.
C run003.no-token-none OL RUN-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not replace request cancellation with CancellationToken.None unless the operation must outlive the request. ;; = ;; Must outlive the request. ;;
C arc025.translate OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Translate remote responses into the abstraction Application consumes / explicit outcomes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-response-mapping EX ARC-025,API-003 MUST_NOT ;; Do not blindly call EnsureSuccessStatusCode when remote statuses carry meaning; do not expose every upstream status through your API or map every upstream failure to the same status. ;; = ;; none ;; Response-mapping rules beyond ARC-025.
C run017.honor-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Honor Retry-After on remote 429 when the retry policy supports it; outbound retry and inbound responses are separate decisions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.before-retry OL RUN-016 MUST ;; Before enabling retry determine transience, repeat safety, idempotency support and duplicate risk; state-changing safety from idempotency keys, idempotent semantics or deduplication; PUT/DELETE not assumed safe by definition. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-headers EX - MUST_NOT ;; Apply per-request values (dynamic tokens) to the request or via a handler; do not mutate shared default headers concurrently. ;; = ;; none ;; Header-safety rule not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-serialization EX - PREFER ;; Prefer System.Net.Http.Json/System.Text.Json with explicit options when external contracts differ. ;; = ;; none ;; Serializer preference not in the oracle.
C arc025.no-domain-contracts OL ARC-025,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not reuse internal Domain entities as remote API contracts to avoid mapping. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run005.test-scope OL RUN-005 ALLOWED ;; Constructing HttpClient directly in a focused test is fine; the lifetime rule concerns production code. ;; = ;; Tests. ;;
C run005.no-per-request OL RUN-005 MUST_NOT ;; No new HttpClient per request. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.log-levels EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Log what helps diagnose/operate; choose levels by operational meaning (Trace/Debug troubleshooting; Information meaningful events, not every method call; Warning recovered degraded conditions; Error failed operations needing investigation; Critical subsystem cannot continue). ;; = ;; none ;; Log-level taxonomy not in the oracle.
C run013.avoid-interpolation OL RUN-013 AVOID ;; Avoid string interpolation in log calls (use message templates). ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec010.all-levels OL SEC-010 MUST ;; Sensitive-data rules apply at every log level. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api012.log-at-handler OL API-012 MUST ;; Log an exception at the boundary that handles or terminates it; no extra log when rethrowing without meaningful handling. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.log-scopes EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use ILogger.BeginScope when several entries share contextual data. ;; = ;; none ;; Scope technique (EXC-013).
C x.log-correlation EX RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Prefer platform trace identifiers; explicit correlation id only when required; propagate tracing context via the chosen infrastructure. ;; = ;; none ;; Correlation technique (EXC-013).
C sec003.normalize-correlation OL SEC-003 MUST ;; Validate or normalize a correlation identifier accepted from an external client before propagating it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.specific-properties OL RUN-014,SEC-010 MUST ;; Avoid logging authorization headers and full sensitive bodies; log specific needed properties. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.loggermessage OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Normal structured ILogger logging suffices; LoggerMessage source generation only for measured high-volume hot paths. ;; = ;; Measured hot path. ;;
C x.log-no-audit-db EX - AVOID ;; Do not use logs as an audit database without a dedicated audit design. ;; = ;; Adopted audit design. ;; Not in the oracle.

C x.serilog-bootstrap EX DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Use two-stage bootstrap initialization when startup logging matters; simpler apps may use host-managed setup. ;; = ;; Simpler applications. ;; Bootstrap technique not in the oracle.
C dep021.addserilog-not-useserilog OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Register with builder.Services.AddSerilog() (DI-integrated) rather than builder.Host.UseSerilog(). ;; = ;; none ;;
C run013.templates OL RUN-013 DEFAULT ;; Use message templates; interpolation breaks structure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.config-in-appsettings OL DEP-021 DEFAULT ;; Keep levels, sinks and overrides in appsettings to vary per environment. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep021.serilog-apis-boundary OL DEP-021,DEP-010 MUST ;; Keep direct Serilog APIs (Log.Logger, LogContext) at composition or provider-specific boundaries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep001.sinks-needed OL DEP-001 MUST ;; Sinks/enrichers beyond Console are not baseline; configure only what the project needs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run014.limit-destructuring OL RUN-014 MUST ;; Limit destructuring or destructure specific properties; large object graphs cause memory issues and massive entries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.serilog-flush EX - DEFAULT ;; Flush the static/bootstrap Log.Logger on shutdown; for host-managed logging follow the provider lifetime instead. ;; = ;; none ;; Serilog lifecycle technique.
C x.serilog-elastic-sink EX DEP-004 DEFAULT ;; Serilog.Sinks.Elasticsearch is deprecated; use Elastic.Serilog.Sinks for Elasticsearch. ;; = ;; Only when Elasticsearch is used. ;; Package guidance not in the oracle.
